newsitem.title: UK: Evergreen receives first of new ship series.
newsitem.headline: Evergreen receives first of new ship series.

text.p: Evergreen Marine Corp (Taiwan) Ltd said Monday it had taken delivery of the first in a series of 10 large containerships from Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd.
A statement issued by Evergreen's European headquarters in Hamburg said the ship, Ever Dainty, was delivered by Mitsubishi's Kobe yard on July 25.
With a capacity of 4,173 twenty foot equivalent units (teu) the ten ships will be deployed in Evergreen's westbound round-the-world service.
All the vessels will be delivered by the end of 1998.

After completion of the 'D'-class vessels, Mitsubishi will build a further eight 5,364 teu containerships for the Taiwanese transport group for delivery by the end of 1999 at a total cost estimated at around US$600 million. -- Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017
